en.text.closing_thanks: Thank you to the speakers, to the brethren for administering the sacrament, to the accompanist, the chorister, the ushers, the interpreter, and to all others who took part in this meeting. We welcome you back to our meetings next Sunday!

en.text.sacrament_intro: We will prepare for the sacrament by singing the sacrament hymn. After the hymn, the sacrament will be blessed and passed to the congregation. The sacrament bread is gluten-free and dairy-free.
en.text.sacrament_prayers:
Blessing on the bread
O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this bread to the souls of all those who partake of it, that they may eat in remembrance of the body of thy Son, and witness unto thee, O God, the Eternal Father, that they are willing to take upon them the name of thy Son, and always remember him and keep his commandments which he has given them; that they may always have his Spirit to be with them. Amen.

Blessing on the water
O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee, in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this water to the souls of all those who drink of it, that they may do it in remembrance of the blood of thy Son, which was shed for them; that they may witness unto thee, O God, the Eternal Father, that they do always remember him, that they may have his Spirit to be with them. Amen.

Thank you for your reverence during the sacrament. Next ...
en.text.sustaining_footer: Those in favor of sustaining him/her/them may do so by raising their hand. [Pause.] If any are opposed, they may also so indicate. [Pause.]
